ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web image shows a label for “Mayfly nymph” on the left and “Dragonfly nymph” near the center. A green arrow points from the mayfly nymph toward the dragonfly nymph, indicating that mayfly nymphs provide food/energy to dragonfly nymphs. Reasoning: If the mayfly nymph population gets smaller, then dragonfly nymphs have less food available. With less food, the dragonfly nymph population would tend to decrease.
